text:
jess: Quick heads-up — Crescent Labs (dedicated) cutover planned Thu 04:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go by EOD PST tomorrow. Can we confirm rollback plan + pinned model versions?

mike: on my calendar. what's the target model bundle and infra slice?

jess: bundle = redwood-openv2-1, quant profile = q8_compat. infra slice = ded-slice-7 (4xA100). pin digest below.

jess: ```
model: redwood-openv2-1
digest: sha256:9f3a2b7c1d5e6f8a3b4c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7
config: quant=q8_compat,batching=auto,kv_caching=prefix-only
```

anil: Confirmed. We'll keep canary traffic at 3% for 30m, then 25% for 30m, then full. Rollback thresholds: error rate >1.5% OR 95th latency >1200ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows.

sara: CS has notified Crescent Labs about the 04:00 UTC window and planned rollback policy. They've asked for a 2-hour maintenance window notice; sent their ops contact an invite.

kyle: ops checklist: preflight smoke tests, KV cache warmers, model load-time metric. Will run them 1h before cutover. Also validating node autoscale limits in ded-slice-7.

deploy-bot: rollout job created: id=rl-45789, target=ded-slice-7, bundle=redwood-openv2-1@sha256:9f3a2b7c..., strategy=staged-canary, canary=3%, step_duration=30m, escalation=pipeline

deploy-bot: scheduled window Thu 2026-04-02T04:00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T06:00:00Z, owner=jess

mike: Safety question — do we have an immediate fallback variant (smaller model or quant fallback) if latency spikes but accuracy must remain OK?

anil: Yes — fallback route pinned to redwood-openv2-1-quant64 (lighter) with automatic traffic shift if latency thresholds breach. We'll keep the same tokenizer. Fallback rule config: `policy: latency-first, shift=50% over 5m`

jess: Good. Also pinning customer-specific config so their traffic won't auto-upgrade to global canary builds. Confirmed in release notes: "Crescent Labs — pinned model redwood-openv2-1 (q8) ; fallback -> redwood-openv2-1-quant64"

sara: Noted — I'll include that in the customer-facing release notes and the maintenance mail.

kyle: Preflight runbook (short):
1) 03:00 UTC — reserve infra and warm caches
2) 03:15 UTC — run smoke tests (health, sample prompts)
3) 03:30 UTC — snapshot metrics + create rollback marker
4) 03:45 UTC — set canary policy and deploy 3%
5) 04:15 UTC — evaluate canary; if ok increase to 25%
6) 04:45 UTC — final ramp to 100%
7) 05:00-06:00 UTC — monitoring + gradual de-slice of upgrade helpers

anil: Add: if any rollback is triggered, we clear KV cache and rehydrate the previous model variant. Also create an incident channel automatically: #incident-crescent-dedicated if rollback occurs.

jess: Can someone from SRE be on-call for the window? @ops-oncall ?

ops-oncall: I can take primary for the window. I'll be on Slack and pager ready.

mike: One more ask — pin deployment manifest to the repo and attach release notes to the rollout job. I can push a commit after we finalize the digest.

deploy-bot: action required: attach_release_notes to rl-45789 (run `/deploy attach-notes rl-45789 path=release-notes/crescent-2026-04-02.md`)

jess: I'll drop the draft release notes here by EOD PST. If no objections, proceed with scheduling. :thumbsup:

sara: :thumbsup: from CS. Crescent Labs has asked for the maintenance email to go out 6 hours prior; I'll schedule it once notes are final.

mike: All good from Eng-Platform side. No infra conflicts reported.

anil: SRE good with thresholds. I'll prepare rollback automation runbook and post here before EOD.

jess: Great — locking in. Final go/no-go thread tomorrow 17:00 PST. Thanks everyone.
